assessment_notes: A single request triggered 9 real tool executions (4 structured-data tools + 5 separate search_manual/Titan-embedding calls) and a 9,048-character final reply in 58.5s - well beyond what MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS=5 suggests should be possible. Bedrock's Converse API allows multiple toolUse blocks per single output message, and _run_tools (bedrock_utils.py) executes every block found - so the 5-iteration cap bounds round trips, not total tool-call volume. This is a real, previously-undocumented amplification path: one HTTP request, no rate limiting on top, can still drive meaningfully more backend/Bedrock cost than the iteration cap implies.
